deckTitle: The Diagnostic Toolkit: The Detective's Gear

cards.power: The Narrative-Unlock. Listens to the Wrestler's Story to build the Initial-Differential.
cards.lore: The Social-Interface. Most matches are won or lost in the first 5 minutes of talking.
cards.gradeReason: Unlocks the match before touching. Best 80% sensitivity tool, zero cost, zero rads.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Watercolor kayfabe. Subject: Owl detective and bulldog wrestler sharing glowing story scroll. Mood: Trust.

cards.power: The Surface-Scan. Sees the Butterfly-Rash and Cyanosis-Blue before a word is spoken.
cards.lore: Visual pattern recognition. The Wrestler-Body wears its Name-Tag on its skin if you know how to look.
cards.gradeReason: See the butterfly rash before speaking. Pattern recognition is the real first move.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Watercolor kayfabe. Subject: Eagle firing laser-gaze at sick lion revealing glowing rash patterns. Mood: Alert.

cards.power: The Deep-Touch. Feels the Liver-Edge and Rebound-Scream to find internal structural riots.
cards.lore: Haptic feedback. Using the hands as a Manometer to judge tissue tension.
cards.gradeReason: Deep touch finds the organ riot but organomegaly needs hands-on training to actually feel.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Watercolor anatomical kayfabe. Subject: Octopus tentacles probing glowing liver and organs. Mood: Probing.

cards.power: The Echo-Check. Taps walls to hear if Lung-Balloons are full of Drown-Water or Air-Ghosts.
cards.lore: Acoustic resonance. Different densities produce different Sound-Stats. The low-tech ultrasound.
cards.gradeReason: Tap those body walls. Air rings hollow. Fluid thuds dull. The free ultrasound.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Watercolor kayfabe. Subject: Woodpecker and horse wrestler surrounded by THUMP TAP BOOM ECHO sound waves. Mood: Rhythmic.

cards.power: The Internal-Whisper. Amplifies Valve-Clicks and Lung-Crackles to hear the Rhythm-Rebels.
cards.lore: Acoustic amplification. Bridges the External-Arena to the Internal-Soundtrack.
cards.gradeReason: Bridge the outside to the inside soundtrack. Crackles and murmurs speak first.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Watercolor kayfabe. Subject: Snake coiled as stethoscope with glowing chest piece. Mood: Tense listen.

cards.power: The Circuit-Test. Taps Nerve-Triggers to see if the Brain-Bunker connects to the Muscle-Engine.
cards.lore: The Monosynaptic-Loop. A hardware test bypassing conscious control.
cards.gradeReason: Tap the trigger and see if brain wires reach the muscles. Grade the gap instantly.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Watercolor kayfabe. Subject: Kangaroo striking knee with reflex hammer triggering lightning arc. Mood: Electric.

cards.power: The Pressure-Verdict. Measures Highway-Pressure to find Shock-the-Stumble.
cards.lore: Hemodynamics. Uses a Pressure-Squeeze to briefly halt the Blood-Flow-River.
cards.gradeReason: Squeeze the arm, listen for highway pressure. Shock lives in the numbers.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Watercolor kayfabe. Subject: Python squeezing arm with pressure gauge showing vital numbers. Mood: Gripping.

cards.power: The Riot-Indicator. Measures Arena-Heat. High heat means the Immune-Army is brawling.
cards.lore: Core temperature monitoring. The thermal-sensor for systemic metabolic activity.
cards.gradeReason: Measure the arena heat. Fever above 38 means the immune army is brawling.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Watercolor kayfabe. Subject: Fire-breathing lizard fused with thermometer glowing orange-red. Mood: Burning.

cards.power: The Drum-Check. Looks through the Ear-Tunnel to see if the Eardrum-Shield is broken.
cards.lore: Direct visualization of the Middle-Ear-Arena. A micro-spotlight for narrow tunnels.
cards.gradeReason: Snoop the tunnel. Broken eardrum shield found. Micro-spotlight for narrow passages.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Watercolor kayfabe. Subject: Ring-tailed lemur aiming otoscope beam into giant eardrum close-up. Mood: Precise.

cards.power: The Window-to-the-Brain. Looks at the Retinal-Wallpaper to see pressure signs from the brain.
cards.lore: Direct observation of microvasculature. The only place to see Vessel-Vines without a scalpel.
cards.gradeReason: Eye window to the brain. Only place to see vessel-vines without opening anything.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Watercolor kayfabe. Subject: Wide-eyed tarsier with magnifying lens examining glowing retinal sun. Mood: Revealing.

cards.power: The Pattern-Magnifier. Looks through Surface-Reflection to see deep mole pigment patterns.
cards.lore: Surface microscopic visualization. Removes Skin-Glare to see internal architecture.
cards.gradeReason: Polarized lens removes skin glare but ABCD criteria needs training to deploy correctly.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Watercolor kayfabe. Subject: Chameleon shining polarized light on pigmented mole revealing hidden fractal pattern. Mood: Investigative.

cards.power: The Throat-Gateway. Pulls back the Tongue Wall to see cords and clear the path for the Breath-Pipe.
cards.lore: Direct visualization of the Airway-Entrance. Essential for choke-matches.
cards.gradeReason: Pull back tongue wall to see airway cords. Grade 1-4 view rewards practiced hands.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Watercolor kayfabe. Subject: Robotic pelican head illuminating pink vocal cord arena with laser blade. Mood: Urgent.

cards.power: The Supply-Line. Creates a permanent bridge into the Blood-River for Chemical-Allies.
cards.lore: Venous access. The docking-port for systemic interventions.
cards.gradeReason: Build the permanent bridge into the blood river. Chemical allies need a docking port.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Dark watercolor kayfabe. Subject: Cybernetic mosquito inserting glowing cannula into neon blood vessel. Mood: Precise.

cards.power: The Precision-Strike. Delivers a micro-dose of medicine directly into a muscle or vein.
cards.lore: Targeted medication delivery. The sniper-rifle of the pharmacy.
cards.gradeReason: Precision strike directly into muscle or vein. The sniper rifle of the pharmacy.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Dark watercolor kayfabe. Subject: Hummingbird-syringe hybrid hovering with glowing green medicine drop. Mood: Surgical.

cards.power: The Arena-Breach. Opens the Wrestler-Body-Walls so the Blade-Brigade can fix the internal riot.
cards.lore: Surgical access. The ultimate physical differential-solver—open the door if you can't see.
cards.gradeReason: When you can't see inside, breach the walls. The ultimate physical differential-solver.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Dark watercolor kayfabe. Subject: Marlin-blade fish slicing chrome arena walls releasing internal light. Mood: Decisive.

cards.power: The Reservoir-Empty. Snakes through the Exit-Tunnel to drain the Bladder-Basin.
cards.lore: Urinary decompression. Bypasses lower Obstruction-Outlaws.
cards.gradeReason: Snake through exit tunnel to drain. Bypasses obstruction outlaws but requires technique.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Dark watercolor kayfabe. Subject: Blue eel-catheter with glowing balloon tip navigating dark bladder cave. Mood: Deliberate.

cards.power: The Immediate-Reveal. Looks into the Belly-Arena at the bedside to find Internal-Leaks instantly.
cards.lore: Acoustic reflection. Sound waves bounce off Organ-Walls to build a live-action map.
cards.gradeReason: Bedside immediate reveal. Zero rads to find internal leaks. The point-of-care champion.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Blue watercolor kayfabe. Subject: Big-eared bat with ultrasound tablet showing live heart sonar map. Mood: Instant.

cards.power: The Engine-Scan. Watches Valve-Doors and Muscle-Walls in real-time to see why the pump stalls.
cards.lore: Real-time cardiac ultrasound. Measures flow-velocity and wall-motion.
cards.gradeReason: Watch valve doors and muscle walls in real-time. Engine-scan sees why the pump stalls.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Blue watercolor kayfabe. Subject: Dolphin projecting echolocation waves into glowing anatomical heart model. Mood: Flowing.

cards.power: The Traffic-Cop. Hears the speed of the Blood-River to find the Clot-Monster blocking the pipe.
cards.lore: Frequency shift. Measures the speed of moving red cells to identify blockages.
cards.gradeReason: Traffic cop for blood speed. Clot-Monster hiding in the pipe? Doppler hears it.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Blue watercolor kayfabe. Subject: Bloodhound scanning color-coded red-blue artery flow map for blockage. Mood: Tracking.

cards.power: The Leak-Hunter. Scans 4 pits to see if Internal-Bleed-Hank is hiding after a crash.
cards.lore: Identifying free fluid in potential spaces. Calls the Blade-Brigade immediately if positive.
cards.gradeReason: Crash scene four-pit scan. Find Internal-Bleed-Hank hiding before the shock hits.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Blue watercolor kayfabe. Subject: Cheetah sprinting sonar waves across downed trauma wrestler scanning four glowing pit zones. Mood: Urgent.

cards.power: The Skeleton-Reveal. Shines light through flesh to see snapped Bone-Pillars or Gunk in the lungs.
cards.lore: Ionizing radiation. Dense structures block photons, casting a white shadow on the plate.
cards.gradeReason: Shine radiation through flesh. Dense things cast white shadows. Fast and cheap.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Dark neon kayfabe. Subject: Bioluminescent jellyfish shining through glowing skeleton on black background. Mood: Revealing.

cards.power: The Highway-Glow. Injected to Light-up tunnels so Roent-the-Shadow can see them.
cards.lore: Radiopaque material. Fills hollow spaces to map internal flow-highways.
cards.gradeReason: Inject iodine dye to light up the highways for Roent. Renal risk is the price.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Dark neon kayfabe. Subject: Rocket-squid injecting neon green contrast into glowing pipe network. Mood: Illuminating.

cards.power: The Road-Map. Shows exactly where a Clot-Monster has blocked a Heart-Pipe.
cards.lore: Real-time X-ray (Fluoroscopy). Guides the Stent-Builder into the correct spot.
cards.gradeReason: Real-time X-ray maps the exact clot-monster blockage. Gold standard, no guessing.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Dark neon kayfabe. Subject: Spider robot weaving glowing red coronary map with arterial web. Mood: Precise.

cards.power: The Tunnel-Map. Coats the Gut-Walls to show if there is an Apple-Core narrowing the exit.
cards.lore: High-density contrast. Does not absorb, mapping the geography of the GI-Arena perfectly.
cards.gradeReason: Chalky drink coats gut walls passively. Player watches; no active performative wrestling move.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Dark neon kayfabe. Subject: Hippo drinking glowing chalk liquid as neon intestine map lights up. Mood: Diagnostic.

cards.power: The 3D-Cross-Section. Spins thousands of Roent-Shadows into a sliceable 3D-Virtual-Wrestler.
cards.lore: Rotating X-ray source. Identifies Stroke-Mist and Internal-Bleed with high speed.
cards.gradeReason: Thousands of X-ray slices become a sliceable 3D virtual wrestler. Speed is the power.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Watercolor kayfabe. Subject: Armadillo spinning through glowing CT donut rings generating 3D holographic slices. Mood: High-tech.

cards.power: The Pipe-Watch. Uses a rapid contrast flash to see if Lung-Highways are blocked before O2 crashes.
cards.lore: Fast CT combined with IV contrast. The gold standard for sudden cardiovascular catastrophes.
cards.gradeReason: Emergency pipe watch catches the PE clot before oxygen crashes. Gold standard move.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Watercolor kayfabe. Subject: Cheetah leaping through holographic lung with glowing blocked pulmonary artery highlighted. Mood: Emergency.

cards.power: The Micro-Lung-View. Looks at tiny Air-Sacs to find Scar-Fiona or Emphysem-the-Pop.
cards.lore: Ultra-thin slices focused on lung parenchyma. Sees Pattern-Secrets standard CT misses.
cards.gradeReason: 1mm slices reveal tiny air sac scarring. Requires knowing which pulmonary patterns to hunt.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Watercolor kayfabe. Subject: Giant moth examining magnified lung cross-section slices revealing honeycomb scarring. Mood: Meticulous.

cards.power: The Tissue-Typer. Looks at a grey spot and judges if it's Air-Ghost, Fluid-Pool, or Solid-Tumor.
cards.lore: Numerical scale of radiodensity. Allows the Slice-Master to be mathematically precise.
cards.gradeReason: Explains HU scale numerically rather than inviting a clear performative wrestling move.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Watercolor kayfabe. Subject: Owlish judge scanning tissue grey spots on -1000 to +1000 HU scale panel. Mood: Analytical.

cards.power: The Soft-Tissue-God. Uses magnetism to see Brain-Wiring and Tumor-Miners with perfect clarity.
cards.lore: Nuclear Magnetic Resonance. Flips the Proton-Spin of water molecules to build a high-resolution map.
cards.gradeReason: Flip the proton spin. Brain-wiring and tumor-miners visible. No metal. The soft-tissue god.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Purple electric kayfabe. Subject: Iridescent lizard wrapped in MRI magnetic field rings glowing with brain-map inside. Mood: Omniscient.

cards.power: The Shadow-Highway. Sees blood flow without Contrast-the-Painter, safe for renal-failure wrestlers.
cards.lore: Imaging focused on moving protons. Maps the Vessel-Vines using only the magnetic field.
cards.gradeReason: Maps vessels without contrast, safe for renal failure. Support technique needs lab context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Dark purple kayfabe. Subject: Deep-sea anglerfish with bioluminescent lure mapping dark blood vessel tunnel network. Mood: Silent.

cards.power: The Ischemia-Blinker. Finds where cells are swelling and dying, catching a Stroke-Stall long before CT.
cards.lore: Brownian motion of water. In acute stroke, water gets trapped inside cells, glowing bright white.
cards.gradeReason: Stroke-stall caught in minutes before CT sees anything. Trapped water glows white.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Dark purple kayfabe. Subject: Dragonfly hovering over black-and-white brain with bright white acute stroke spotlight. Mood: Critical.

cards.power: The Breach-Finder. Highlights where the Blood-Brain-Barrier is broken by tumors or scars.
cards.lore: Paramagnetic enhancement. Shortens Proton-Reset-Time, making specific tissues glow brilliantly.
cards.gradeReason: Chelated rare earth boosts MRI signal at the blood-brain barrier breach. Support tool.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Dark neon kayfabe. Subject: Psychedelic frog dripping chelated dye onto brain cross-section revealing tumor breach points. Mood: Enhancing.

cards.power: The Hunger-Map. Uses Radio-Sugar to see who is eating the most. Malignant-Max is always hungry.
cards.lore: Positron Emission Tomography. Active cells (Cancer, Inflammation) consume more glucose.
cards.gradeReason: Malignant-Max is always hungry. Radio-sugar finds the cancer feast instantly.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Dark neon kayfabe. Subject: Hyena tracking radioactive red glowing hotspots on skeletal prey using glucose tracer. Mood: Predatory.

cards.power: The Air-vs-Flow-Check. Compares Air-Balloons to Blood-Highways. If air goes in but blood doesn't, it's a clot.
cards.lore: Nuclear isotope mapping. A Mismatch is the signature of a Pulmonary Embolus.
cards.gradeReason: Air in but blood out is the PE signature. Mismatch concept needs isotope-imaging context.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Dark neon kayfabe. Subject: Two tortoises — one breathing blue air, one pumping red blood — showing mismatch arrows. Mood: Comparative.

cards.power: The Repair-Radar. Looks for where Bone-Builders are working overtime fixing fractures or fighting tumors.
cards.lore: Osteoblastic activity. The tracer binds to hydroxyapatite where new bone is being laid down.
cards.gradeReason: Bone builders working overtime? Tracer finds fractures and tumors by their repair glow.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Dark neon kayfabe. Subject: Vulture hovering over glowing green radioactive skeleton with bright hot-spot tumors. Mood: Scanning.

cards.power: The Bile-Highway-Test. Injected tracer flows into the Liver-Factory; if it misses the gallbladder, the door is blocked.
cards.lore: Hepatobiliary scintigraphy. Tracks the functional flow-logic of bile through the pipes.
cards.gradeReason: Tracer flows to liver factory then checks gallbladder door. Bile anatomy context required.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Dark neon kayfabe. Subject: Beaver swimming in glowing green bile river checking blocked gallbladder dam. Mood: Tracking.

cards.power: The Electrical-Witness. Writes the heart's playbook. Finds the STEMI-Fire and the Chaos-Quiver.
cards.lore: Surface voltage measurement. Maps the depolarization wave traveling through the heart muscle.
cards.gradeReason: 12 leads write the heart's electrical playbook. STEMI fire and chaos quiver visible immediately.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Electro watercolor kayfabe. Subject: Electric centipede riding ECG scroll with P-QRS-T spikes crackling. Mood: Charged.

cards.power: The Lung-Power-Gauge. Measures how much Air-Fuel the wrestler can blow and how floppy the lungs are.
cards.lore: Spirometry. Differentiates Obs-the-Blocker (Asthma) from Res-the-Restrictor (Fibrosis).
cards.gradeReason: Measure lung bellows power. FEV1/FVC ratio interpretation requires spirometry reading skill.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Electro watercolor kayfabe. Subject: Elephant blowing WHOOSH into giant spirometer gauge measuring airflow tornado. Mood: Powerful.

cards.power: The Mind-Rhythm-Reader. Watches electrical storms in the Brain-Bunker to find the Silent-Seizure-Spark.
cards.lore: Scalp electrophysiology. Records the summation of neuronal firing to detect rhythm ruptures.
cards.gradeReason: Brain electrical storms mapped on scalp. Silent seizure spark found before it goes loud.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Electro watercolor kayfabe. Subject: Ram with electrode helmet showing Delta-Theta-Seizure waveforms in lightning-colored arcs. Mood: Electric.

cards.power: The Power-Line-Check. Pokes Muscle-Engines to see if Nerve-Wires deliver the move command.
cards.lore: Electromyography. Differentiates Nerve-Deadness from Muscle-Wither.
cards.gradeReason: Poke the muscle to test nerve wire delivery. Nerve vs muscle distinction requires reading skill.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Electro watercolor kayfabe. Subject: Porcupine quill-electrode firing into glowing red muscle fiber showing nerve conduction trace. Mood: Diagnostic.

cards.power: The Cell-Snatch. Takes a micro-sample to see if cells look like normal citizens or Malignant-Max-Punks.
cards.lore: Cytological sampling. The least-invasive way to get a look inside a suspicious mass.
cards.gradeReason: Micro-sample with 22-25G needle. Cells either look normal or Malignant-Max-Punk.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Watercolor pink kayfabe. Subject: Ant with micro-syringe extracting glowing purple cell sample from tumor mass. Mood: Minimally invasive.

cards.power: The Structural-Sample. Takes a solid plug so the Patho-Detective can see how tumor miners are arranged.
cards.lore: Histological sampling. Seeing tissue architecture is essential for grading breast and prostate miners.
cards.gradeReason: Solid plug sample for tissue architecture. 14-18G core needs pathology reading to complete.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Watercolor pink kayfabe. Subject: Toucan extracting cylindrical tissue plug core biopsy from pink tumor mass. Mood: Precise.

cards.power: The Internal-Snatch. Grabs a piece of the Arena-Wall (Gut, Lung) to check for invasion.
cards.lore: Direct visualization + biopsy. Identifies the enemy while looking right at the damage scene.
cards.gradeReason: Camera snake grabs arena wall tissue while watching the invasion happen live.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Watercolor pink kayfabe. Subject: Robotic scorpion camera-endoscope gripping pink gut tissue with claw forceps inside arena wall. Mood: Direct.

cards.power: The Total-Removal. Takes the entire lump out of the ring, giving the whole story and fixing the match.
cards.lore: Surgical removal. The final verdict on any suspicious wrestler skin spot.
cards.gradeReason: Total removal gives the whole story and fixes the match simultaneously. Dual power card.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Watercolor pink kayfabe. Subject: Honey badger ripping entire tumor mass out of ring leaving clean arena behind. Mood: Decisive.

cards.power: The Brain-Bunker-Report. Draws liquor from the spinal basement to see if Meningi-the-Riot is attacking.
cards.lore: CSF analysis. The direct data line to the Central Nervous System.
cards.gradeReason: Tap the spinal basement. CSF is the direct brain data line. Meningitis caught here.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Watercolor golden kayfabe. Subject: Crane bird extracting glowing CSF droplets from illuminated spinal column. Mood: Delicate.

cards.power: The Drown-Relief. Drains fluid around the Lung-Balloons so the wrestler can breathe.
cards.lore: Pleural fluid analysis. Differentiates Heart-Fail-Flood from Infection-Fire.
cards.gradeReason: Drain the fluid drowning the lungs. Fluid analysis answers heart-fail-flood or infection-fire.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Watercolor golden kayfabe. Subject: Pelican draining yellow pleural fluid from drowning lung balloon into collection vessel. Mood: Relief.

cards.power: The Ascites-Audit. Drains the Water-Belly to see if the liver factory is failing or if tumors are leaking.
cards.lore: Peritoneal fluid analysis. SAAG tells you if the problem is pressure or invasion.
cards.gradeReason: Drain the water belly and audit the SAAG score. Pressure or invasion? Tap to find out.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Watercolor golden kayfabe. Subject: Tapir trunk draining golden ascites fluid from ballooned abdomen with SAAG score readout. Mood: Relieving.

cards.power: The Joint-Secret. Drains the swollen knee to see if the riot is caused by uric needles or bacterial punks.
cards.lore: Synovial fluid analysis. Essential for saving a joint from septic destruction.
cards.gradeReason: Drain the swollen knee and spy: uric crystals or bacterial punks causing the riot?
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Watercolor golden-red kayfabe. Subject: Praying mantis draining glowing synovial fluid from inflamed knee revealing crystal needles. Mood: Revelatory.

cards.power: The Ghost-Finder. Takes a tiny blueprint scrap and copies it millions of times until the enemy is visible.
cards.lore: Polymerase Chain Reaction. The microscopic megaphone for viral code scraps.
cards.gradeReason: Copy the viral blueprint scrap millions of times until the enemy becomes visible. Ghost finder.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Neon purple kayfabe. Subject: Robot chameleon duplicating DNA helix strands exponentially until glowing pathogen appears. Mood: Amplifying.

cards.power: The Code-Spotter. Uses a neon flashlight to find a specific genetic typo or missing page.
cards.lore: Molecular cytogenetics. Lights up specific sequences right on the chromosome.
cards.gradeReason: Neon flashlight finds the specific genetic typo right on the chromosome. Clear mission.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Neon purple kayfabe. Subject: Bioluminescent wasp firing pink laser probe at glowing chromosome strand highlighting gene target. Mood: Targeted.

cards.power: The Army-Sorter. Shoots cells through a laser to find Leukemia-Punks by their unusual uniforms.
cards.lore: Laser-based cell counting. Identifies the phenotype of thousands of cells in seconds.
cards.gradeReason: Laser sorts thousands of cells per second. Leukemia-Punks caught by their unusual uniforms.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Neon purple kayfabe. Subject: Robot fish shooting red laser through cell parade revealing CD-marker uniformed leukemia punks. Mood: Sorting.

cards.power: The Source-Code-Master. Reads every single letter to find hidden glitches and future risks.
cards.lore: High-throughput sequencing. The final verdict on the genetic fate of the wrestler.
cards.gradeReason: Read every single genetic letter. The final verdict on the wrestler's genetic fate.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Neon green Matrix kayfabe. Subject: Mechanical owl reading cascading ATCG genetic code wall as whole genome scrolls. Mood: Omniscient.

cards.power: The Tool-Strategist. Choose the fastest tool for the emergency, and the deepest tool for the mystery!
cards.lore: The master of all sensors. Don't use a Tesla-Titan when a Stetho-Listener can solve the match!
cards.gradeReason: Orchestrate all tools strategically. The meta-card that gives the whole deck its philosophy.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Confetti kayfabe. Subject: FrizzleBob rabbit doctor in lab coat holding glowing stethoscope-snake summoning brain hologram. Mood: Mastery.

cards.power: Deploy: Lar-the-Voice-Mirror.
cards.lore: Use the gateway tool to see the subglottic squeeze and prepare for the breath-pipe.
cards.gradeReason: Clinical scenario deploys Lar correctly. Brilliant synthesis but needs gameplay context to fully land.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Confetti kayfabe. Subject: Bear wrestler clutching throat with barking cough and airway X-ray showing subglottic squeeze. Mood: Critical.

cards.power: Deploy: FAST-the-Trauma-Seeker.
cards.lore: Use the immediate-reveal tool to find the internal blood pool before calling the blade brigade.
cards.gradeReason: Deploy FAST for hidden belly bleed. Elegant synthesis but needs game context to execute.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Confetti kayfabe. Subject: Rhino wrestler with rigid belly surrounded by red warning triangles awaiting FAST scan. Mood: Emergency.

cards.power: Deploy: DWI-the-Stroke-Spotter.
cards.lore: CT shows no bleed mist. Use DWI to find the trapped water signal of an acute stroke-stall.
cards.gradeReason: CT clear but DWI solves it. Perfect clinical reasoning chain needs table context to engage.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: Confetti kayfabe. Subject: Gorilla wrestler with question-mark head beside clear CT and ticking clock awaiting DWI answer. Mood: Tense.

verdict: Diagnostic Toolkit delivers what almost no educational deck achieves: every tool name is already a wrestling move you want to perform, from Anamnes-the-Profiler's Narrative-Unlock to Next-Gen-the-Total-Reader's Source-Code-Master. The Diagnostic Attending as meta-orchestrator plus three Synthesis Quest scenarios at the close are strokes of genius — this isn't card trivia, it's clinical reasoning in kayfabe form. Single weak link: Houndsfield-the-Density-Judge slips into number-lecture mode when it could've been a snap verdict call. Cover artwork is peak FrizzleBob — treasure chest exploding with diagnostic gear will stop every medical student mid-scroll. Table-ready: YES.
blurb: For medical students and healthcare workers who learn better through story than textbook. 56 cards transform every diagnostic tool — from stethoscope to whole-genome sequencer — into a character with a move, a stat, and a reason to remember.

'Listen to the body, then look through the walls' as subtitle is FrizzleBob philosophy in twelve words. The rat shouting 'Call Doc Frizzle!' is pure brand gold.

All STAT boxes add genuine clinical value — Anamnes: Sens 80% / $0 Cost / 0 Rads is brilliant framing. Three Synthesis Quest scenario cards (54-56) function as clinical reasoning problems, a structural device not seen in other decks — worth developing as a series feature.

Consider Synthesis Quest 4: The Bone Pain scenario to round out the series

marketingText:
MedKayfab: THE DIAGNOSTIC TOOLKIT – The Detective's Gear (Medical Mnemonics Cut & Play Comic)

56 illustrated medical mnemonic cards to master what each diagnostic instrument actually measures, when a stethoscope still beats a Tesla-strength scanner, and how to climb from the bedside to the imaging suite without skipping the cheap answer.

Every diagnosis runs on the same quiet escalation. You begin with the cheapest sensor you own, your own hands and ears, and you climb to the next instrument only when the body refuses to answer. The skill the toolkit drills, and the one most students walk straight past, is knowing which rung to stand on. Order a PET scan for a question a stethoscope could have settled and you have spent a thousand euros and a week to learn what one minute at the bedside already knew. Stay too long on the bedside when imaging was the only honest witness, and you let the lesion sit in the dark and grow.

MedKayfab: The Diagnostic Toolkit turns that escalation ladder into a narrative wrestling match, where every instrument from the Stetho-Listener to the PET scanner is a character fighting to be the one you reach for, each with a physical signal it can read and a blind spot it will never admit to. You win by knowing exactly what a sensor measures and exactly what it cannot.

YOU'LL GET
- 56 illustrated MedKayfab cards (14pp, 4 cards/page)
- Full MedKayfab Freestyle rules (Quest Die mechanics)
- S-Tier characters like PET-the-Sugar-Seeker, DWI-the-Stroke-Spotter, and Ophthalmo-the-Eye-Spy
- Free lifetime updates as imaging and diagnostics evolve
- CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 licence
- PDF optimized for home printing (A4 / Letter)

What's in the deck
This deck personifies the "Inference" layer of medicine, the moment between the complaint and the answer. You will meet PET-the-Sugar-Seeker, who finds the hungriest cells in the body because cancer and inflammation eat glucose faster than anything around them, and lights them up while everyone else is still guessing. You will meet DWI-the-Stroke-Spotter, who reads the panic of water trapped inside dying neurons and pins an acute stroke to the map in minutes. And Ophthalmo-the-Eye-Spy, the one instrument that looks through a living window straight at the body's smallest vessels and reads the whole circulation off a single retina. Behind them stands The Diagnostic Attending, the master of every sensor, who knows that you do not call in a Tesla-Titan when a Stetho-Listener can settle it for free.

How it works
Every card is a cognitive anchor built for high-stress retrieval. You get the Character (the mnemonic), the Visual (the scene), the Stat Block (what it measures, what it costs, what it misses), the Lore (the clinical story), and the Quest (the diagnostic challenge). The Mechanism Flash mode is the test: name the physical signal the instrument reads in one sentence without looking, or the "patient" on the Stage gets the wrong scan and the diagnosis slips away.

Honest cognitive load
This is an A-Tier inference engine, broad rather than deep, and it sits well early. It suits preclinical and early clinical students building the map of what each tool is for, and it earns its keep again later as a fast refresher before a clinical-skills exam or an imaging viva. It pairs naturally with Radiology and Medical Imaging for the physics behind the scanners, and with Internal Medicine or Emergency Medicine, where the right instrument at the right minute is the whole game.
